slot.brief: Give a medium-length word and four options; ask which option word can be formed using only the letters of the given word, each letter used at most as many times as it appears.

stem: Which of the following words can be formed from the letters of **NOTEBOOKS**, using each letter no more often than it occurs in the given word?

verdicts.working: NOTEBOOKS contains B, K, S once each and O three times, so BOOKS can be formed. The other options require a missing P or a repeated N or T.

working:

BOOKS uses available letters.
STOOP needs three Os; BONNET needs two Ns; TOOT needs two Ts.
